subject.declared_domain: resolution of an arbitrary estate reference to canonical node ids, across the graph / compiler / repo / cloud id spaces, with a stated confidence

methodology.how: Pure function, lru_cached, composing FOUR resolvers in a declared precedence order: (1) trace_graph via .comp-graph/graph.json, (2) the comp_pydeps compiler layer, (3) repo tracked-file basenames, (4) cloud-ref shapes (ARN / s3:// / hyphenated cloud name). Returns Resolution{ref, node_ids PLURAL, kind, confidence, source}. Three lookup indices are built from the graph: by_path, by_base, by_leaf -- the last catching bare function names and bare artifact keys that have no file_path basename to match on. An unresolvable ref returns kind=UNADDRESSED with the raw ref preserved rather than being dropped.

verdict.why: THE DESIGN IS SOUND AND THE SUBSTRATE IS NOT -- and the two must not be collapsed. Composition-over-reimplementation, plural node_ids, stated confidence bands and UNADDRESSED-as-a-finding are exactly the properties an estate-wide entity spine needs, and this is the only declared cross-space mapping found to date. But three measured defects block load-bearing use: (1) its primary substrate is 19.7 DAYS stale with NO cadence and NO named owner, so nothing will ever refresh it on a schedule; (2) graph-tier coverage is 2,249 of 27,061 = 8.3%, which is a sample rather than a spine; (3) the failure mode is SILENT and indistinguishable from a true negative, so a degraded resolver and a correct one produce identical output. UNSOUND is a verdict about STANDING AS LOAD-BEARING SUBSTRATE TODAY, not a judgement on the design, and all three defects are remediable without redesign.
